verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes LocalAI's own agents acting as an MCP *client* — connecting to external MCP servers for tools/live data (localai-docs-4, localai-docs-24, localai-docs-25, localai-docs-33) — not LocalAI exposing an official MCP server that external agents can plug into. Per the client/server distinction, this client-side capability cannot be credited toward the 'official MCP server' story, and no evidence shows LocalAI itself running as an MCP server endpoint.
